description: This file implements a Flutter widget for a Location screen, with pixel-accurate layout using absolute positioning, loading assets from specific asset paths, and containing UI components such as a header, search bar, map placeholder, and confirmation button.

classes.name: Location0126Screen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the location selection screen with pixel-perfect layout, including map, search, and confirmation button.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the location screen, composing header, search bar, map area, and bottom details.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns a custom Figma header bar widget with the title 'Location'.

methods.name: searchBar
methods.description: Creates a static search bar widget with icon and placeholder text, styled to match design.

methods.name: mapArea
methods.description: Creates a placeholder map area with decorative assets and a location pin at center.

methods.name: bottomDetails
methods.description: Creates a bottom sheet-like container with current location info and a confirm button that navigates back.

methods.name: pImg
methods.description: Helper function to position images precisely within the layout from assets/figmaimages.
